title: UI/UX Design With AI | Saylani Mass IT Training
text: Course: UI/UX Design With AI. Category: Designing. Duration: 4 months. Description: Helps students master modern user experience and interface design using traditional design principles and AI-powered workflows: UX research, Design Thinking, wireframing, prototyping, and visual design. This course is offered free of cost by Saylani Mass IT Training (SMIT), an initiative of Saylani Welfare International Trust. Admission is via the online registration form at https://www.saylanimit.com/enroll, selecting this course and a preferred campus/city. (Source: SMIT official AI data feed, saylanimit.com/llms-full.txt)
